## Phone: nothing behind the bars, in every theme
- The area behind the tab bar, the mini player and the "Playing on …" bar is now plain page colour down to the screen edge in every theme, Liquid Glass and Green included
- The strip grows with whatever floats at the bottom, so songs, covers and artists no longer show next to, between or under the bars
- Taps there do nothing; only the bars themselves react
- Only on phones, the PC app and desktop browsers stay as they were

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
